summary: In late September 2026, Oracle sent a force majeure notice to the developer of Project Jupiter, a Stargate-class data-center campus in New Mexico. The clause can defer rent or payments if the campus misses its planned online date, which means committed AI capacity can reprice through contract outs and energy gates.
watch: The next force majeure notice on an AI campus, and whether private-credit packages for similar campuses reprice once contract outs start firing.
